verdict_notes: PASS after one fix: non-deterministic ordering in getSettledPicks() (settled_at ties from batch settles) could silently change streak/divider claims between page loads. Fixed with a deterministic secondary sort (id asc). All other areas passed on first pass.

accuracy_verification.method: Direct Postgres query via DATABASE_URL (.env.local), independent of the app and of the build agent's own numbers

bugs_found.description: getSettledPicks() ordered only by settled_at, which is identical across an entire settle-job batch. No guaranteed tiebreak means SQL tie order (and therefore streak/divider claims) is not guaranteed stable across requests.
bugs_found.fix: Added .order("id", { ascending: true }) as deterministic secondary sort in src/lib/sports/soccer/queries.ts getSettledPicks().
bugs_found.verified: Re-ran the page 3x post-fix, same '4 wins in a row' each time; cross-checked against direct SQL with the same tiebreak.

environment_issues_resolved_not_code_bug.description: Süper Lig rendered gold instead of its red theme on first load; compiled CSS chunk was missing the [data-competition="tur.1"] rule (committed after the long-running dev server started). Resolved by full `.next` wipe + restart, not a code change.

checklist.prefers_reduced_motion_gated: pass (verified via source + compiled CSS; live OS-level toggle not available in this headless tooling)
